notes:
RoHelper 1.0.0

Activity: combined account runtime, real-world uptime graphs, concurrency and resource charts, account leaderboards, activity calendar, daily goals, personal records and saved session summaries.
Compact client health: session timer and last anti-AFK input, with expandable automation and CPU/RAM/GPU details.
53 cached, data-driven achievements with milestone progress, XP and a trophy shelf. Definitions update through the public game-data repository; unlocks and statistics stay local in AppData.
Sleep and unobserved time are excluded. Matching sessions resume across app restarts without adding offline time. Existing account data is preserved.
